Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing provisions awarding prevailing party fees and costs for appeals of land use decisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prevailing party fees and costs for appeals ofland use decisions; creating a new section; and repealing RCW 4.84.370.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 4.84.370 (Appeal of land use decisionsFees and costs) and 1995 c 347 s 718 are each repealed.
The repeal of RCW 4.84.370 appliesretroactively to any litigation that is pending as of the effectivedate of this section.
